records.purpose: Establish comparison of measurable attributes before reading scales or using standard units.
records.setup: Use two objects that can be aligned directly and a third reference object for indirect comparison.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 这两个物体哪个更长？如果不能放在一起比较，可以借助什么共同参照物？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Which object is longer? If the two objects cannot be placed together, how could a common reference help us compare them?
records.expected_thinking: Direct and indirect comparison can preserve the same ordering of length when the comparison attribute is held constant.
records.listen_for: Judging length from position, orientation or visual placement rather than the measured attribute.
records.variation: Use a balance to compare mass.

records.title_en: Why do we need standard units?
records.purpose: Show why non-standard units can produce different counts and why agreed standard units make measurements comparable.
records.use_when: Introducing centimetres, metres, grams, kilograms or capacity units.
records.setup: Measure the same desk using two pupils' hand spans, then use a ruler.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 同一张桌子为什么用两个人的手掌量会得到不同数字？换成厘米后，什么变得固定了？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Why can two people get different counts when measuring the same desk with hand spans? What becomes fixed when we use centimetres?
records.expected_thinking: Non-standard units vary in size; standard units have an agreed fixed size, allowing measurements to be compared.
records.listen_for: Thinking the object's length changed because the numerical count changed.
records.variation: Compare measuring a distance in footsteps and metres.

records.purpose: Interpret unit conversion as keeping the quantity constant while changing the size of the unit used to count it.
records.setup: Use 3 metres and a metre-centimetre relationship.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 3米等于多少厘米？为什么换成更小的单位后，数字反而变大？实际长度变了吗？
records.teacher_prompt_en: How many centimetres are in 3 metres? Why does the number become larger when the unit becomes smaller? Did the actual length change?
records.expected_thinking: The same quantity contains more smaller units, so the numerical measure increases while the physical quantity remains unchanged.
records.listen_for: Applying a multiply/divide rule without predicting the direction of change.

records.title_en: Choose a sensible unit before estimating
records.purpose: Use familiar benchmarks and unit size to make reasonable measurement estimates.
records.setup: Ask for estimates of a pencil length, classroom length and road distance.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 教室的长度大约是多少？你会选毫米、厘米、米还是千米？用一个熟悉的参照物说明估计。
records.teacher_prompt_en: About how long is the classroom? Would you use millimetres, centimetres, metres or kilometres? Use a familiar benchmark to justify the estimate.
records.expected_thinking: A reasonable estimate depends on both magnitude and a suitable unit.
records.listen_for: Choosing a number without considering the unit or expected scale.
records.variation: Estimate a pencil length and a road distance with different units.

records.title_en: Read the two clock hands with different scales
records.purpose: Coordinate hour and minute scales and recognise that the hour hand moves continuously.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 分针指6为什么表示30分？3:30时，时针为什么不正好停在3上？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Why does the minute hand on 6 mean 30 minutes? At 3:30, why is the hour hand no longer exactly on 3?
records.expected_thinking: The minute hand counts five-minute intervals; the hour hand moves continuously through the hour.
records.listen_for: Reading both hands with the same scale; assuming the hour hand stays fixed until the next hour.

records.title_zh: 把经过时间分成容易计算的段
records.title_en: Break elapsed time into manageable intervals
records.purpose: Treat elapsed time as distance between two times rather than ordinary base-ten subtraction.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 从9:45到10:20经过多久？先走到10:00，再走到10:20。两段各是多少？
records.teacher_prompt_en: How much time passes from 9:45 to 10:20? First move to 10:00, then to 10:20. How long is each interval?
records.expected_thinking: 9:45 to 10:00 is 15 minutes and 10:00 to 10:20 is 20 minutes, giving 35 minutes in total.
records.listen_for: Subtracting 45 and 20 as ordinary decimal digits; losing the 60-minute hour structure.

records.title_en: Calculate duration across a month boundary
records.purpose: Use the actual calendar structure when calculating dates and durations.
records.setup: Use a real calendar and a start date near the end of a month.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 从3月25日开始过10天是哪一天？为什么不能假设每个月都是30天？
records.teacher_prompt_en: What date is 10 days after March 25? Why can we not assume that every month has 30 days?
records.expected_thinking: Calendar calculations must respect the actual number of days in each month and leap-year structure where relevant.
records.listen_for: Treating every month as the same length.
records.variation: Compare the same duration starting on April 20.

records.title_en: More coins do not necessarily mean more value
records.purpose: Separate the number of coins or notes from their total monetary value.
records.setup: Compare two 50-cent coins with five 10-cent coins.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 2枚50分和5枚10分，哪一组价值更大？为什么不能只看硬币数量？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Which is worth more: two 50-cent coins or five 10-cent coins? Why is the number of coins not enough to decide?
records.expected_thinking: Two 50-cent coins total 100 cents while five 10-cent coins total 50 cents; count and value are different quantities.
records.listen_for: Choosing the group with more physical coins without calculating value.
records.variation: Find two different coin combinations with the same total value.

records.title_zh: 找零表示两个金额的差
records.title_en: Change is the difference between two amounts
records.purpose: Connect change to subtraction and difference rather than a detached money rule.
records.setup: Use an item costing 37 yuan and a 50-yuan payment.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 商品37元，付50元，应找多少？13元在这个情境里表示哪两个金额之间的差？
records.teacher_prompt_en: An item costs 37 and you pay 50. How much change is needed? What two amounts does the 13 represent the difference between?
records.expected_thinking: Change is the difference between the amount paid and the price; subtraction and counting up can represent the same difference.
records.listen_for: Obtaining 13 numerically but being unable to state what it represents.
